title: Asymptotics of completed Maiorana--McFarland extensions
summary: Determine tight asymptotic cardinalities for the closest bent functions to the completed Maiorana--McFarland class and its indicator-extension closure.

formal_statement.body: Let $\mathcal M_{2n}$ be the strict Maiorana--McFarland class and let $\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}$ be its extended-affine closure. Let $\widehat{(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})}$ be the class obtained by adjoining every bent function $f\oplus\operatorname{Ind}_U$ generated from $f\in\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}$ and an $n$-dimensional affine subspace $U\subseteq\mathbb F_2^{2n}$ on which $f$ is affine. Define $N(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})=\widehat{(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})}\setminus\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}$. Determine asymptotically tight formulas, as $n\to\infty$, for both $|N(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})|$ and $|\widehat{(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})}|$.

scope.domain: Cardinalities of completed Maiorana--McFarland bent-function classes
assumptions: $\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}$ is the extended-affine closure of the strict Maiorana--McFarland class
$\widehat{(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})}$ uses the source indicator construction $f\oplus\operatorname{Ind}_U$
$N(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})$ contains the newly generated closest bent functions outside $\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}$
parameters: $n$: half the number of Boolean variables
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source derives asymptotics for $|\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#}|$ and upper bounds for $|N(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})|$ and $|\widehat{(\mathcal M_{2n}^{\#})}|$. Matching lower bounds, and hence asymptotically tight behavior for both requested cardinalities, remain unknown.

progress.summary: Open Problem 2 asks for the asymptotic behavior of both requested cardinalities, while Remark 8 identifies the missing lower-bound side.
